g.text: Iteration II conceptual domain model — refinement of iteration1/DMupdated.drawio.png
{at most one non-cancelled Appointment per slot}
{OPEN iff no current occupant; BOOKED otherwise}
Cancelled appointments retain the historical slot link.
Supplied criteria are combined; dates are inclusive.
Acceptance alone leaves WAITING and creates no hold.
Sample CSV descriptions alone do not establish an entry.
Each predefined resource is one allocatable unit.
Role units are not tied to specific personnel.
{no overlapping active allocations of the same unit}
